items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And also Gussick was another drummer there. [INTERVIEWEE] Gussick? ... [INTERVIEWER] ... I think that's Bill Gussick. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: He was a real hell bent for leather. And one side of Chauncey's I guess Variety records, there's Johnny Williams playing it. 'I'll Build a Stairway to Paradise' the other side. He's all over the drums whereas Chauncey was a more subtle drummer and more variety whereas Johnny Williams really went at it. And I think Williams was on the Saturday Night Swing Club with Leith Stevens. And also Gussick was another drummer there.
